plan.title: directive doctor: read-only, one next action with root-cause + remediation rationale

narratives.Description: Make `directive doctor` diagnostic-only and decision-oriented: it inspects health, states the operating mode plus version reconciliation, and emits exactly one next command paired with a root-cause and a remediation rationale, and it never mutates project files. It derives every finding from the shared keystone plan() schema rather than a second classifier, suppresses secondary migration advice until the primary blocker clears, never recommends a bare task command in a project with no Taskfile, and surfaces cross-platform engine skew.
narratives.Overview:
Part of epic #2203. Absorbs #2200.

## Summary

Make `directive doctor` diagnostic-only and decision-oriented: inspect health, report findings, emit exactly one next command **with its reason**, and never mutate.

## Behavior (Decision 3 addendum, Decisions 6/4)

- Read-only. Inspects install integrity, AGENTS/managed-section state + sha, toolchain, layout, xBRIEF/vBRIEF state, engine-vs-pin-vs-`VERSION` skew.
- Derives findings from the same `plan()` schema as #child A (#2264) / #child E (no second classifier).
- States the **operating mode** ("This project is in hybrid mode; engine v0.65 global, content v0.65, pin v0.65 -- current").
- Emits exactly one `Next command:` when action is required, each paired with a two-part rationale: **root cause** (why the finding exists) + **what the remediation does / why it is safe**. Example:

```text
Finding: .deft/core is tracked in git but hybrid mode expects it gitignored.
  Root cause: legacy vendored install predates the hybrid cutover.
Next command: directive migrate --untrack-core
  Does: removes .deft/core from the git index + adds the ignore entry; content
  is reconstituted from the pinned engine, so nothing is lost.
```

- Suppresses secondary migration advice until the primary blocker is resolved (no contradictory instructions for one state).
- Never recommends a bare `task ...` in a project without Taskfile wiring; prefers `directive ...`.
- Surfaces cross-platform engine skew (Windows-native vs Linux-sandbox `.deft/.cli/<platform>` divergence).
- The `migrate --untrack-core` remediation this doctor points at is the verb SHIPPED by #2269 (merged); this story owns the doctor-side detection + emission.

## Acceptance criteria

- Never mutates project files.
- Exactly one primary next command when action is required, with root-cause + remediation rationale.
- No contradictory migration instructions for the same state; no bare `task` without a Taskfile.
- States operating mode + version reconciliation; surfaces platform skew.
- Tests cover pre-cutover, legacy `vbrief`, missing Taskfile, current xBRIEF, partial install, and mismatched-env states.

## Related

Absorbs #2200. Depends on #child A (#2264). Parent #2203.
narratives.UserStory: As a Directive consumer running any command, I want `directive doctor` to be strictly read-only and derive its findings from the shared plan() schema so it reports the operating mode plus exactly one next command with a root-cause and remediation rationale, so that I get one unambiguous safe next action instead of contradictory migration advice or bare task commands in a project with no Taskfile.
narratives.ImplementationPlan:
1. In `packages/core/src/doctor/main.ts` (cmdDoctor) and `packages/core/src/doctor/checks.ts`, route findings through the shared keystone `plan()` from `packages/core/src/resolution/` so there is a single classifier: build the finding set + the single nextAction {command, rootCause, remediation} from plan() output rather than doctor-local re-detection. Add/extend `packages/core/src/doctor/types.ts` for the finding+rationale shape.
2. Guarantee read-only: audit cmdDoctor and its helpers so no code path writes project files in the default report mode; keep any state write confined to the existing throttle-state file only (doctor-state.ts) and cover it with a no-mutation test.
3. Emit exactly ONE primary `Next command:` when action is required with the two-part rationale, and suppress secondary migration advice until the primary blocker clears (ordered precedence from plan()); state the operating mode + engine/pin/VERSION reconciliation; surface cross-platform `.deft/.cli/<platform>` skew.
4. Never print a bare `task ...` remediation in a project with no Taskfile wiring -- prefer `directive ...`; reuse `doctor/taskfile.ts` detection to choose the phrasing.
5. Colocated vitest in `main.test.ts` / `checks.test.ts` covering pre-cutover, legacy vbrief, missing-Taskfile, current-xBRIEF, partial-install, and mismatched-env states plus the no-mutation guard. Wire the CLI in `packages/cli/src/doctor.ts` if the finding surface changes. Add a brief CHANGELOG entry. Run `task ts:check-lane`, targeted vitest, and `task check:framework-source`.
